title: Template preview
lede: A preview built from last week's research to test the page. Not a published edition.

radar.headline: Saves are the signal on hair-only clips
radar.detail: The best stylist TikToks of the fortnight were saved at 20–40% of their likes: one blonde result with 'BLONDE INSPO' on screen, 42.7K likes and 7,071 saves.

radar.headline: A client's own words as the opening line
radar.detail: The largest stylist post of the fortnight opened on a quote, 'I want to go darker but not brown', over a 12-second reveal with the formula in the caption.

radar.headline: Named shades travel
radar.detail: 'Bambi bronde', 'Cinnamon', 'teddy bronde'. A name clients can search is doing the hook's job.

ideas.title: The client's words, then the fix
ideas.hook_preview: I want to go darker but not brown.
ideas.summary: Open on the exact sentence your client said in the consult, show how you read it, land on the result.
ideas.concept: Every colour client arrives with a sentence. Put that sentence on screen over her before, show the one or two decisions it drove (where you kept brightness, where you added depth), then the after. For stylists, swap the hook to the decision itself.
ideas.why: The biggest stylist post of the fortnight opened on a client quote and did 610K plays with the formula in the caption. Clients recognise themselves; stylists save the decision.
hooks: "I want to go darker but not brown." (on screen, over the before)
Here's how I read 'darker but not brown' on a level 9 blonde. (voiceover, stylist-facing)

essential: Before, in daylight, ends and root visible (ask the client)
One clip of you mixing or placing the first section
nice: 3 seconds of the consult, eye level

structure: Two decisions, one line each on screen or spoken (6–8s)
talking_points: Name the two things the sentence told you: tone and depth
Say where the brightness stayed and why
Say what you'd adjust next visit
ideas.voiceover: She told me she wanted to go darker but not brown. To me that means: keep the brightness around the face, add depth everywhere else, and gloss it warm, not ashy. So I lowlighted through the mids, kept her money piece, and glossed in a soft beige. Still a blonde. Just a deeper one.

caption.goal: Carry the formula and ask for the send.
caption.example: If you've ever said this to your stylist, send her this.

adapt: Cutting: 'shorter but I still want to put it up'
Extensions: 'longer but I don't want it to look fake'

inspiration.label: @weronikaciemna · TikTok · Sept 18 · 610K plays, 1.7K shares
inspiration.note: Quote on screen, 12 seconds, formula in caption

ideas.inspiration_note: The quote-as-hook is what we saw. Building the two decisions into it is our idea.
ideas.next_note: You already have the sentence. Film the before and after.

ideas.title: Name your fall colour
ideas.hook_preview: My most requested colour right now: [your name for it]
ideas.summary: Give your signature shade a name, show it, show where she started, put the formula in the caption.
ideas.concept: Pick the colour you're doing most this month. Give it a name you own. Show the result for 8 seconds with the name on screen, cut to the starting point, then one frame of the formula.
ideas.why: Named shades are what's moving (Bambi bronde, Cinnamon). A named shade with 'most requested right now' earned 2,392 saves on 68K plays.
hooks: My most requested colour right now: Toasted Chestnut. (on screen)
Everyone's asking for 'something warmer'. This is what I'm mixing. (voiceover)

essential: The starting point (a before, or last visit's after)
A still of the bowl or the formula card

talking_points: Why this colour suits fall light

caption.goal: The name, the formula, a send ask.
caption.example: Send this to whoever keeps saying 'something warmer'.

adapt: Blonde: your version of Baby Blonde or Peach Blonde
Vivid: name the placement, not the colour

ideas.title: The consult, at eye level, then the cut
ideas.hook_preview: She's had the same haircut for nine years.
ideas.summary: Sit at eye level, let her say what she wants in her own words, cut to three decisions, land on the result.
ideas.concept: A 45-second real consultation about a cut she's nervous to change, then selected process footage and the result. The conversation gives the viewer a reason to care about the cut.
ideas.why: Consultation-led stories are an established format (Taya's own consult videos). This is the experiment: a cut rather than colour, with the client's nerves as the story.
hooks: She's had the same haircut for nine years. (on screen over the consult)
Here's how I talk a nervous client into layers without scaring her. (stylist-facing)

essential: Consult at eye level, 45–60s, phone on a tripod (ask the client)

structure: One line back to her goal
talking_points: The one change you made that solved it

caption.example: If you've been thinking about it for nine years, this one's for you.

ideas.experiment_note: Consult videos are proven for colour. We haven't seen the 'nervous to change her cut' version done well. Worth testing.
